# v0.4 visual assets

Arena, portraits and character sprites were created with the available built-in image generation tool from the user-approved fusion design. No specific image model version is claimed. Optimized WebP assets are served locally.

Icons: @phosphor-icons/core 2.1.1, MIT. See icons/LICENSE.

Three.js actors use painted billboard sprites, not skinned character meshes. PNG generation masters and design mockups are not part of the deployed dist directory.
